name: celsius-app
description: Celsius - un store d'applications pour Windows et Android. Installe, met a jour et lance tes apps depuis les GitHub Releases.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test: node scripts/test-semver.mjs && node scripts/test-resolve.cjs && node scripts/test-catalog.mjs && node scripts/test-store.mjs && node scripts/test-platform-target.mjs
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --publish never
